comparison.objective: Turn off a named rotary isolator and padlock its handle at OFF; candidate finishes four inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Rotary switch actuation and padlock manipulation versus coaxial mandrel holding, separately manipulated hammering, and tang retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Target isolator OFF and handle padlocked; no specs or lock tolerances provided. Candidate requires four fractures, preserved hardware, fragment containment, and stable release.
comparison.reason: Tests control isolation and locking, not fracture of retained insert tangs.
